model_annotation: This circular chart compares the relative proportions of public funds, institutions, and economically active enterprises (FEU) of municipalities and municipal associations by task areas in the years 2014 and 2021. The chart is divided into 13 segments, each representing a different category. The categories include 'Öbige' (35.1%), 'Klinken' (11.8%), 'Verkehr' (6.2%), 'Kultur' (3.3%), 'Sonstige' (4.1%), 'Sport/Erholung' (3.6%), 'Wohnungswesen' (7.2%), 'Abwasserentsorgung' (7.0%), 'Abfallwirtschaft' (2.1%), 'Stromversorgung' (8.9%), 'Gasversorgung' (1.5%), 'Wasserworsorgung' (5.5%), and 'Kommunale Verwaltung' (1.3%). The chart does not include a legend, but the percentages are displayed within or next to each segment. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, with 'Öbige' being the largest segment occupying over a third of the chart, and 'Kommunale Verwaltung' being one of the smallest.
